verdict.rationale: Docs confirm virtual card creation via a single API call (Card/Cardholder objects), sandbox testing tools, and a marketing claim of going live 'in minutes, not months' (stripe-issuing-docs-1, -21, -23, -25), but there is no explicit documentation of PAN/CVV being returned programmatically at issuance, and community reports describe historical invitation-only onboarding gating access to production, undercutting the 'no sales cycle' claim (stripe-issuing-comm-4, stripe-issuing-comm-7). missing for 10: explicit doc confirming PAN/CVV/expiry returned in the create-card API response, current evidence that invitation-only gating has been removed, independent hands-on confirmation of instant sandbox-to-live transition.
